post:
Thank you, Satya, and good afternoon, everyone. Our results exceeded expectations across revenue, revenue, operating income, and earnings per share. Driven by strong demand across the Microsoft cloud. This quarter, revenue was $92.3 billion up 19% gross margin dollars increased 17% and gross margin percentage was 68% operating income increased 21% and 22% 22% in constant currency earnings per share was $4.89 and increase of 18% and 19% in constant currency when adjusted for the impact for our investment in OpenAI.

And FX was roughly in line with guidance. Operating expenses increased 6% driven by continued investments in R&D compute capacity and talent, operating margins increased slightly year over year to 50% driven by strong revenue growth platform efficiency gains and focused investments across our portfolio.

partially offset by sales mix shift to Azure. When adjusted for the impact for our investments in OpenAI
